verdict.rationale: Pomelo is an API platform, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. The evidence pack does not document an OpenAPI or equivalent download, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The MCP server's endpoint search and code generation is a different capability and does not count toward a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
